execution_notes: API methods ran in separate processes with 10.2 seconds between HTTP requests per process.
The first 36 single-shot predictions ran sequentially with a 3.2-second request interval.
An interrupted in-flight single-shot request is not included in per-prediction usage totals.
Elapsed times include throttling and are not controlled latency comparisons against the low run.
Both runs used the same 50 images, checkpoint, nutrition database, prompts, temperature, and 8192-token output budget.
One run per reasoning level of a mutable model alias; bootstrap intervals reflect dish sampling, not repeat-generation variability.
